onboard sweep #2: 17 onboarded, PPPS smart on all, shelves HELD (poweroff-race fix working); 2 no-adb belugas joined via SSH path; device-side auto-join re-seats watches without operator action
the 17-wall decomposed into 4 independent causes: blocked-row bug, .15 collision, adb-server-only detection blindness, faulty sockets — NOT slot exhaustion during serialized onboarding

.15 SSH collision: reboot returns watches to shared default (allocation not persistent), multiple RNDIS links shadow each other behind one route; 2s ping timeouts per dead allocated IP = the constant 4.25s render
in-service warmer did not fire the stray peel during the one live window though the identical sequence works manually — needs one more observation

eliminated: w541 software stack (fastboot works on chassis port), host wiring (0afe on both USB2 and USB3 host ports), wedged hub state (full cold-boot no change), A16 design (other sockets pass), the watches, the map sequence
